criteria.name: answer_schema_and_final_label
criteria.description: Returns the six requested top-level JSON fields with units encoded in field names and gives antecedent_wet_high_mobility_river_blockage.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for a recoverable JSON object with one missing or renamed field; award 1 point for the right label without a usable ledger.

criteria.name: rainfall_calculation
criteria.description: Computes 218.2 mm antecedent load, 4.13 mm event-day gridded maximum, and 52.83 antecedent/event-day ratio within tolerance.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct rainfall values with one rounding or ratio error; award 1 point for using the right variables but not completing the ratio.

criteria.name: landslide_extent_ledger
criteria.description: Reports 40 mph, 0.5 sq mi, 18 million tons, and 36.0 million tons per square mile.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for two or three correct extent values or for a correct density formula with one wrong input.

criteria.name: river_and_context_calculations
criteria.description: Reports 25 ft, 2.5 mi, 62.5 ft-mi, and context_index_per_100k = 132.51.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a correct river product or context formula with one incorrect input or rounding error.

criteria.name: threshold_score
criteria.description: Applies all eight threshold checks, including the three-part direct-impact index, and reports 8 passed out of 8.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for mostly correct threshold logic with one or two missed pass states.

criteria.name: label_rule_reasoning
criteria.description: Connects the 8 of 8 score and passing rainfall-ratio check to the final label.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the correct label without clearly tying it to both required conditions.

criteria.name: concise_computed_interpretation
criteria.description: Keeps the interpretation tied to the computed ledger and avoids adding extra outcome estimates.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a correct but wordy interpretation that does not change the computed result.
